release.notes: Organized Class Games with one eight-game picker, compact Play/Records tabs and grouped Start/sound/settings controls. Replaced HulaLetra browser confirmations with Talino-styled Keep playing / Reveal answer dialogs. Removed General attendance fallback choices from Class Games and Prayer; named subjects are required, with scheduled-class selection when available. Aquarium now offers a read-only All subjects view including earlier saved points. Includes HulaLetra, multi-section exam creation and all previous features. Existing classroom records, settings and activation are preserved.
